80004302.desc: #c[Angelic Buster]# \nSets up a series of mobile spotlights that empower superstars and damage enemies.

80004306.desc: #c[Evan]# \nCast a magical ring to channel the power of the constellations.

80004307.desc: #c[Cannoneer]# \nFire a gigantic rocket from your cannon.

80004308.desc: #c[Adele]# \nCreates a space filled with countless aether swords.

80004309.desc: #c[Aran]# \nHarness the unbreakable will of a hero to unleash a slash enhanced with Maha's power.

80004312.desc: #c[Wind Archer]# \nSummons a ferocious gust to punish your enemies.

80004315.desc: #c[Night Lord]# \nTemporarily grants your throwing skills extra spread.

80004318.desc: #c[Mechanic]# \nUse all available Mech weapons to fire every single one of your bullets at once.

80004320.desc: #c[Blaze Wizard]# \nBlaze through your enemies with the phoenix's symbol of infinite life and death.

80004321.desc: #c[Marksman]# \nMagically enchants your arrows to explode as they approach the enemy, releasing countless more arrows.

80004323.desc: #c[Hoyoung]# \nSummons the guardian of Mt. Songyu, a giant tiger spirit. Every 3 seconds, the tiger gives out a mighty roar to shake heaven, earth, and your enemies.

80004325.desc: #c[Zero]# \nAttack together with a clone to demolish the enemy.

80004333.desc: #c[Lara]# \nCall every type of land spirit in Mother Nature's existence to frolic together.

80004339.desc: #c[Kain]# \nChannel your intrinsic power, then blast it forward. Then, move rapidly, dealing fatal consecutive blows to the front.

80004342.desc: #c[Demon Slayer]# \nSacrifice all your Fury to conjure a malevolent serpent of pure rage.

80004343.desc: #c[Arch Mage (Fire/Poison)]# \nUnleash the fury of flame in the form of an enraged spirit.

80004344.desc: #c[Mercedes]# \nDeal deadly consecutive attacks against your enemies, so they can experience the full wrath of the spirits.

80004347.desc: #c[Ark]# \nSummon a ravenous beast from the Abyssal depths and command it to devour everything in its path.

80004348.desc: #c[Dawn Warrior]# \nUnleash a swirl of galaxies around you.

80004349.desc: #c[Battle Mage]# \nImmerse your surroundings in dark magic and call upon netherworld lightning.

80004352.desc: #c[Wild Hunter]# \nYour crossbow uses Resistance technology to maximize its firepower.

80004354.desc: #c[Phantom]# \nThrows a flurry of cards, stopping to reveal the last one. Will luck be on your side?

80004361.desc: #c[Buccaneer]# \nStrike with all the force of a raging leviathan.
